description: Wärmeplanung (Potentialanalyse) Trier - Potenzial Abwasserkanal is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Trier. The aim of the potential analysis in the urban area of Trier is to estimate the existing potential for heat generation from target-compliant energy sources and the potential for energy savings through heat demand reduction. Coverage: Stadt Trier. The portal shows the English title as "Thermal planning (potential analysis) Trier - potential sewer" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Trier. Its keywords include infoMapAccessService, Energieumwandlung, Wärmeentzugsleistung, Abwärme, Stadtwerke (Wärmeversorgung), Energieressourcen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-02-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
